body.name: \(\mathfrak X_{\mathrm{adm}}\)
body.construction: Fix \(K,p,\iota,\mathfrak G,(\Theta_{\boldsymbol d},\Theta^{\mathrm{in}}_{\boldsymbol d}),q,W,\pi_{\mathrm{ar}},\alpha,w_{\max}\), finite \(\mathcal Z_{\mathrm{cand}}\), \(\mathcal R_{\mathrm{adm}}\subset\Delta_J^{\mathbb Q}=\{r\in\mathbb Q_+^J:\sum_{j=1}^{J}r_j=1\}\), and \(\mathcal N_{\mathrm{adm}}\), and caps \(\mathfrak b\). Let \(\mathfrak X_{\mathrm{adm}}\) contain exactly inputs with \(1\leq J\leq J_{\max}\), \(M\in\{0,\ldots,m_{\max}\}^{J\times K}\), \(\mathcal T\subseteq\mathcal Z_{\mathrm{cand}}\) and \(1\leq|\mathcal T|\leq L_{\max}\), \(\rho\in\mathcal R_{\mathrm{adm}}\), \(1\leq R_s\leq R_{\max}\), \(1\leq s_{\mathrm{tail}}\leq s_{\max}\), \(0\leq a_{\mathrm{TM}}\leq a_{\max}\), \(0\leq b_{\max}\leq b_{\max}^{\mathrm{adm}}\), \(0\leq c_{\max}\leq c_{\max}^{\mathrm{adm}}\), \(N_{\max}\in\mathcal N_{\mathrm{adm}}\), and \(\mathfrak B(\Xi)\leq B_{\max}\). All quantities held fixed have finite representations, so the displayed choices form a finite class.
